headline: Apple posts a Wireless Radio Verification role spanning digital and RF-modeled subsystems
fact: Apple posted a Wireless Radio Verification Engineer role whose description covers radio digital controllers and Digital+RF subsystems spanning PLL, DAC and ADC data paths, power management, and coexistence. The hiring mandate includes UVM environments, constrained-random tests, coverage and assertions, and digital-plus-mixed-signal co-simulation integrating SystemVerilog behavioral and DMS models. In related recruiting posts, Vineet Bhargava invited candidates to the team that verified the N1 radio and Sunil Kumar explicitly said his group was hiring. Their linked requisition is 200632346-3956, distinct from the original 200632358-3956. The posts' exact dates are unverified; the Event retains the original job-posting date.
